format: Control character conformance vectors for text an app sets or inserts. Core (EditBufferRenderable.test.ts) and Rust (tests/widgets.rs) run this file. A row is [name, widget, path, text, expected].

widget is "input" (maxLength 6) or "textarea". path gives the editor text through the constructor, the value setter (setText for a Textarea), or an insert into an empty editor; then "!" is inserted at the end of the text. expected is the text it holds.

Control characters and escape sequences stay (the buffer shows them as notation such as ^G and <85>) and count toward maxLength. Input drops LF and CR. Pastes strip them instead (paste.conformance.json).
rows: an escape sequence counts each character
an insert drops line breaks and keeps BEL
BEL, ESC, form feed and NEL
BEL, ESC, form feed and NEL
an OSC sequence and a tab
